BudgetSettings.description: BudgetSettings configures the budget engine and the planner.

maxStretch.description:
MaxStretch caps the interval stretch factor applied to a priority
class before the planner moves to the next class.

replanInterval.description: ReplanInterval is the period of mid-window replanning.

replanOnProjection.description:
ReplanOnProjection replans at once when the consumption projected by
the current plan until the end of a quota window exceeds its remaining
budget, for example when another client starts spending the same
quota, instead of waiting for the next replanInterval.

retryReserve.description: RetryReserve is the share of every quota reserved for retries, from 0% to 50%.

CircuitBreakerSettings.description: CircuitBreakerSettings configures the per-account circuit breakers.

failureThreshold.description:
FailureThreshold is the number of consecutive transient failures that
opens the circuit.

maxCooldown.description: MaxCooldown caps the cooldown, which doubles on repeated openings.

defaultTimeout.description: DefaultTimeout of a request when the provider sets none.

jitter.description: Jitter spreads scheduled runs, from 0% to 50% of the interval.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: MaxConcurrentRequests bounds in-flight requests across all providers.

DebugSettings.description: DebugSettings configures the live debug endpoint.

enabled.description: Enabled exposes the last raw responses (redacted) in the status API.

maxBodyBytes.description: MaxBodyBytes truncates the raw responses kept for debugging.

level.description: Level: debug, info, warn or error.

labelConflict.description:
LabelConflict resolves labels set both by the mapping and by
account, target or job labels: override (job > target > account >
mapping) or error.

maxCost.description: MaxCost is the CEL cost limit per expression evaluation.

maxItemsPerRun.description: MaxItemsPerRun caps the items extracted by a run.

maxSamplesPerRun.description: MaxSamplesPerRun caps the samples produced by a run.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the document, unique per kind.

RetrySettings.description: RetrySettings configures retries with exponential backoff and full jitter.

maxAttempts.description: MaxAttempts per request, including the first attempt.

multiplier.description: Multiplier of the backoff between attempts.

SecretRef.description: A secret read from an environment variable ({env: NAME}) or a file ({file: /path}).

env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the secret.

file.description: Path of a file holding the secret, relative to the declaring file.

interval.description: Interval between two pushes of the self-metrics to Outputs.

outputs.description: Outputs that also receive the self-metrics (always served on /metrics/self).

ServerBasicAuth.description: ServerBasicAuth protects the server with HTTP basic authentication.

debug.description: Debug is the live debug endpoint exposing raw responses.

tls.description:
TLS serves HTTPS with the given certificate. A reverse proxy is the
recommended way to terminate TLS.

ui.description: UI is the embedded read-only web UI.

ServerTLS.description: ServerTLS holds the server certificate files, relative to the declaring file.

certFile.description: CertFile is the PEM certificate chain.

keyFile.description: KeyFile is the PEM private key.

SettingsSpec.description: SettingsSpec is the specification of Settings.

budget.description: Budget configures the budget engine and the planner.

circuitBreaker.description: CircuitBreaker configures the per-account circuit breakers.

log.description: Log configures logging. Flags and environment variables win.

providerPaths.description:
ProviderPaths lists directories of user provider packages, in
addition to the built-in packages.

retry.description: Retry configures retries of transient errors.

server.description: Server is the HTTP server (metrics, health, status API, UI).

state.description: State is the persistent state store.

path.description:
Path of the SQLite database, relative to the declaring file. The
built-in default is relative to the working directory.
